title: Gujarat Board SSC 10th Result 2026 Declared - Check Your Score at gseb.org
author: Ash K.
summary: GSEB has declared the Gujarat Board SSC (Class 10) Result 2026. Students can check their results at gseb.org or gsebeservice.com using their seat number. Mark sheets will be distributed through schools.
body: The Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board (GSEB) has declared the SSC (Class 10) examination results for 2026. Students who appeared for the Gujarat Board 10th exam can now check their results online.
Results are available at the official GSEB website - gseb.org and gsebeservice.com. Students need their seat number to access their individual results.
How to check your result: Visit gseb.org → Click on 'SSC Result 2026' → Enter your seat number → Click Submit → View and download your result.
Students are advised to take a screenshot or printout of their online result for immediate reference. The original mark sheet will be distributed through respective schools in the coming weeks.

For students who have passed and are planning their next steps - whether it's choosing a stream (Science/Commerce/Arts) or preparing for competitive exams - KnowledgeKendra has guides on career paths after 10th, scholarship opportunities, and exam preparation resources.

Students who need to apply for re-checking or re-evaluation can do so through the official GSEB website within the specified deadline (usually 10-15 days after result declaration). The fee for re-checking is nominal.

faqs.question: Where to check Gujarat Board 10th Result 2026?
faqs.answer: Visit gseb.org or gsebeservice.com and enter your seat number to check your SSC result.

faqs.question: When was Gujarat Board SSC Result 2026 declared?
faqs.answer: The GSEB SSC Result 2026 was declared on May 11, 2026.

faqs.question: How to get Gujarat Board 10th mark sheet?
faqs.answer: Original mark sheets will be distributed through your school. Download the online result as a temporary reference.

faqs.question: Can I apply for re-evaluation of Gujarat Board 10th result?
faqs.answer: Yes, apply through the official GSEB website within 10-15 days of result declaration.

callout.content: Check your Gujarat Board SSC Result 2026 at gseb.org using your seat number. Keep a printout for reference until the original mark sheet is distributed through your school.
